options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Additionally, this sets the default `service` for every log source.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: host
options.description: Enter the host to connect to.

options.name: port
options.description: Enter the port of the host to connect to.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for the connection. Redis 6+ only.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the connection.

options.name: unix_socket_path
options.description: Connect through a unix socket instead of using a `host` and `port`.

options.name: db
options.description:
The index of the database (keyspace) to use.
The default is index 0. Any other index results in a SELECT command sent upon connection
to choose the desired database. For redis.clone, this can also be NA in which case the same database is
used as in rc.

options.name: collect_client_metrics
options.description:
Collects metrics using the `CLIENT` command.
This requires the Redis CLIENT command to be available on your servers.

options.name: disable_config_get
options.description:
Skip all CONFIG GET commands. Enable this for managed backends such as Amazon ElastiCache
that forbid CONFIG commands to avoid rejected requests.
When enabled, redis.net.maxclients is not collected. Slowlog collection uses slowlog-max-len
if configured, otherwise 128.
By default, the first CONFIG GET response error disables all CONFIG GET commands for the
lifetime of the check instance and logs a warning.

options.name: socket_timeout
options.description: Custom timeout for the check request.

options.name: ssl
options.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for the check.

options.name: ssl_keyfile
options.description: The path to the client-side private keyfile.

options.name: ssl_certfile
options.description: The path to the client-side certificate file.

options.name: ssl_ca_certs
options.description: The path to the CA certs file.

options.name: ssl_cert_reqs
options.description:
Specifies whether a certificate is required from the
other side of the connection, and whether it's validated if provided.

  * 0 for ssl.CERT_NONE (certificates ignored)
  * 1 for ssl.CERT_OPTIONAL (not required, but validated if provided)
  * 2 for ssl.CERT_REQUIRED (required and validated)

options.name: ssl_check_hostname
options.description:
Verify the server's SSL certificate hostname matches the connection target.
Redis-py 6.0+ defaults this to true. Set to false if your certificate
does not match the connection hostname (for example, if connecting by IP).

options.name: client_name
options.description:
Set the connection name that appears in CLIENT LIST on the Redis server.
Useful for identifying agent connections. Requires the CLIENT SETNAME permission.

options.name: keys
options.description:
Enter the list of keys to collect the lengths from.
The length is 1 for strings.
The length is zero for keys that have a type other than list, set, hash, or sorted set.
Note: Keys can be expressed as patterns, see https://redis.io/commands/keys.

options.name: warn_on_missing_keys
options.description:
If you provide a list of 'keys', set this to true to have the Agent log a warning
when keys are missing.

options.name: slowlog-max-len
options.description:
Set the maximum number of entries to fetch from the slow query log.
By default, the check reads this value from the redis config, but is limited to 128.
If CONFIG GET is disabled or rejected, the check uses 128 unless a value is configured here.

Set a custom value here if you need to get more than 128 slowlog entries every 15 seconds.
Warning: Higher values may impact the performance of your Redis instance.

options.name: command_stats
options.description: Collect INFO COMMANDSTATS output as metrics.

options.name: disable_connection_cache
options.description:
Enable the connections cache so the check attempts to reuse the same Redis connections
at every collection cycle. If disabled, this prevents stale connections.

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.

options.name: min_collection_interval
options.description:
This changes the collection interval of the check. For more information, see:
https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/write_agent_check/#collection-interval

options.name: empty_default_hostname
options.description:
This forces the check to send metrics with no hostname.

This is useful for cluster-level checks.

options.name: metric_patterns
options.description:
A mapping of metrics to include or exclude, with each entry being a regular expression.

Metrics defined in `exclude` will take precedence in case of overlap.

options.name: logs
options.description:
Log Section

type - required - Type of log input source (tcp / udp / file / windows_event).
port / path / channel_path - required - Set port if type is tcp or udp.
                                        Set path if type is file.
                                        Set channel_path if type is windows_event.
source  - required - Attribute that defines which integration sent the logs.
encoding - optional - For file specifies the file encoding. Default is utf-8. Other
                      possible values are utf-16-le and utf-16-be.
service - optional - The name of the service that generates the log.
                     Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.
tags - optional - Add tags to the collected logs.

Discover Datadog log collection: https://docs.datadoghq.com/logs/log_collection/
